about:
# KerimAnka UI

A modular interface suite for World of Warcraft: Forever and Classic Era, with class-themed artwork,
ready layouts for all nine classes, and a shared settings panel in nine languages.

[Downloads](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/releases) ·
[Report a bug or suggest a feature](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/issues) ·
[Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/kerimanka) ·
[Changelog](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Forever version: **0.40.6**. Classic Era remains **0.37.0**.
[Download the latest release](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/releases/latest)
and choose the attached complete-suite ZIP.

KerimAnka UI brings class artwork, action-button backgrounds, unit frames,
minimap presentation, quest tracking, experience and reputation displays,
threat, sound controls, and profile management into one settings panel.

## Class designs and ready layouts

KerimAnka UI includes class-specific action bar artwork and ready layouts for
**Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue, Priest, Shaman, Mage, Warlock and Druid**.
The package includes all nine classes; it is not limited to Hunters.

Open **Profiles**, choose your current class's ready layout, review the
confirmation and apply it. The preset sets up the class-themed appearance and
layout together. Ready layouts are tuned for 1920 x 1080; other resolutions or
UI scales may need adjustments.

## Screenshots

**The screenshots below show the Hunter design as an example. Each of the nine
classes listed above has its own themed design and ready layout.**

### Hunter ready layout

![Hunter ready layout in the game world](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/main/docs/screenshots/hunter-overview.png)

### Shared settings panel

![Quick Settings panel in English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/main/docs/screenshots/settings-overview.png)

[Class Art settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/main/docs/screenshots/hunter-class-art.png) ·
[Unit Frames preview and settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/main/docs/screenshots/hunter-unit-frames.png)

These screenshots show the Forever client. The world is shown at night, and native
game text follows the player’s German client language.

## Compatibility

Supports **Forever (Interface 16001)** and **Classic Era (Interface 11509)**.
The same complete-suite ZIP includes separate client loaders. Classic Era uses
separate saved settings; its new features have not been ported to Forever yet.
Retail support is not claimed.

Ready layouts are tuned for **1920 x 1080**, with the Classic layouts prepared
at **100% UI scale**. Other resolutions or UI scales may need manual positioning;
automatic rescaling of saved layouts is not included.

## New for Classic Era

- Ready layouts for all nine classes, with optional Bartender4 and Blizzard layout transfer.
- In-game layout editing with quick settings, previews and save/cancel.
- Combined bags and bank, item cooldown counters and saved inventory views.
- Main-hand, off-hand and ranged swing timers; Rogue combo points; player cast bar.
- Energy and mana tick indicators, minimap coordinates and movable clock/day-night controls.
- Optional World latency (MS) beside FPS, disabled by default.

These Classic additions use their own code path. Existing Forever functionality
is retained; this release does not claim the new Classic features for Forever.

## Main features

- Ready layouts for all nine classes, with confirmation before applying a layout.
- Class-themed action bar artwork, minimap presentation and unit frames.
- Supported Blizzard action bars or optional Bartender4 integration.
- Character snapshots, named profiles and import/export.
- Transfer of captured Blizzard Edit Mode and Bartender layouts when available.
- Quest tracking, target threat, experience and reputation displays.
- Sound controls, ready mute groups and custom sound FileDataID entries.
- Hunter range and aspect reminders.
- English, German, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, Spanish,
  Brazilian Portuguese and Russian panel languages.

## Download and installation

Download the current installable package from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/releases/latest).
GitHub Releases contains the reviewed installable ZIP. A GitHub source update
alone does not publish a new CurseForge file.
Prefer the explicitly attached complete-suite ZIP to GitHub's automatic
source-code archives. A source archive contains this repository inside an extra
folder; that containing folder does not belong in Interface/AddOns.

Extract the nine KerimAnkaUI folders directly into the game client's
Interface/AddOns directory. Open the panel with `/kaui`, `/kerimanka`, or the
minimap icon. Follow the first-use guide to Profiles if you want to apply a ready
layout. For updates to an existing installation, replace the addon files and
use `/reload`. Preserve your WTF folder and SavedVariables.

For details, see [the included user guide](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/blob/main/KerimAnkaUI/README.md).

## Optional addons

Bartender4 and Questie are optional. Details! is required only for the optional
Details skin module; it is not bundled. Other third-party addons are not included.

## Contact and feedback

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/issues) to report
a reproducible bug or suggest a feature. Issues and their replies are public
once the repository is public; do not post private information there. Include your addon version, client build, class, action-bar provider,
steps to reproduce, and any Lua error. English reports are welcome.
Review screenshots before posting and do not upload credentials or your entire
WTF folder. The [contribution guide](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains what to include.

Twitch: [KerimAnka](https://www.twitch.tv/kerimanka). Streams are in Turkish;
GitHub Issues is the preferred channel for technical reports.

For private inquiries, email
[kerimanka.twitch@gmail.com](mailto:kerimanka.twitch@gmail.com).
GitHub does not provide a general private messaging inbox.

Version changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Each published
release will also include release notes and an installable complete-suite ZIP.

## Optional support

KerimAnka UI is free to use. If you would like to support its development, you
can [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/kerimcandan).
Support is entirely optional and does not unlock addon features or priority
support. The external payment page may display the creator's public name.

## Third-party notices

The Ubuntu fonts and LibSerialize retain their included license notices.
Third-party licenses do not apply to all project code or artwork.

## License

KerimAnka UI is free to use under the [KerimAnka UI Limited Use License 1.0](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/blob/main/LICENSE).
You may inspect the code and make changes for your own private use. Normal
gameplay streams, videos and screenshots, including monetized content, are allowed.
Redistribution, publication of modified versions, and reuse of project-owned code
or original artwork in another project require prior written permission. This
includes free redistribution and paid bundles. Platform rights and third-party
licenses remain unaffected. This is not an open-source license.
See LICENSE for the full terms and CONTRIBUTING.md before submitting changes.

## Independent Classic Era Bags

The suite includes its own integrated bag feature. The separately downloadable
KerimAnka Bags edition contains only bags, bank and character inventory records
with the familiar settings panel. It does not require the suite. Its folder is
generated during packaging and is never included in the complete-suite ZIP.
When both editions are enabled, the suite takes priority. The independent edition
keeps its own saved settings; no automatic settings migration is performed.
At present only one independent KerimAnka edition can run at a time.
See [product packaging](https://github.com/kerimanka-ui/KerimAnkaUI/blob/main/docs/PRODUCT-PACKAGING.md) for the release layout.

## 0.38.0 client boundaries

The combined archive updates Forever (1.60.1). Classic Era keeps its tested 0.37.0 client files. Generic TOCs select Forever; `_Vanilla.toc` files select Classic Era. `ClassicEra/` stays frozen. Some historical `Classic*.lua` filenames in the Forever hub are adapted Forever implementations, never loaded by Classic TOCs. Separate settings namespaces are retained.

## 0.39.0 Forever update

Updated bag text sizing, Organized categories, native bank integration and menu icons. Optional full-bag grey-item replacement starts off. Experimental guild-bank theme is session-only opt-in (`/kaguildskin on`); `/kaguildpreview` is a read-only example. Real guild operations remain unverified. Classic Era stays at0.37.0. See CHANGELOG.md for details.

## 0.40.1 Forever update

Chat copy/search tools, Unit Frame feedback/predictions and visual improvements, bag hook/tooltip fixes and combat sound switches. Guild bank uses its original appearance by default. Known combat private-tab limitations are documented in CHANGELOG.md. Classic Era remains0.37.0.

releases.name: KerimAnka UI 0.40.6 — Settings search and interface fixes
releases.notes:
# KerimAnka UI 0.40.6 — Settings search and interface fixes

This update targets **WoW: Forever (1.60.1)**. The combined suite download preserves **Classic Era 0.37.0 unchanged**. Existing settings and recorded history are retained.

- **Settings search:** find supported controls across the suite in the selected panel language, with all nine panel languages supported. Search all settings or the current category, jump to the relevant page and tab, expand the needed group and highlight the control. Cursor, unit frames, bags, Hunter settings, threat, minimap, quests, Action Tracker, damage meters, bar appearance, class art, chat, sounds and interface settings are covered where available. Searching does not change a setting. Data/history deletion and profile import/export actions are outside this search.
- **Chat:** fix a conflicting alpha-hook loop when hiding chat controls that could cause a C stack overflow and repeated errors.
- **Bags:** keep the loot window above the visible bag window, restore its prior layer on close and allow dragging the unprotected bag window during combat. Native protected item, sorting and resizing restrictions remain in place.
- **Money display:** use native gold, silver and copper icons in bag wallets, character money lists and the economy view, with icons sized to the text.
- **Hunter range:** add optional approximate PvE range displays, including a single-number estimate when the available evidence supports it. These options are off by default. Wide or unknown ranges retain interval/fallback text; this is not exact coordinate-based distance measurement.
- **Unit frames:** expand player/target buff and debuff positioning, separation and priority controls, and align the live and preview layouts. Player/target vertical distance is shown as an outward distance from 0 to 250; pet and horizontal controls retain their existing behavior.
- **Mail income:** improve matching of delayed mail-failure notifications to confirmed wallet changes without merging distinct sales. Retain the optional `/kamaildebug` support recorder, **off by default** and bounded in memory. Recording starts only when explicitly enabled; personal reports and SavedVariables are not distributed. Existing historical ledger rows are not rewritten.
- **Quest journal:** retain the game-approved QuestJournalRC1 behavior, stable category order and quest menus. Use native quest-header interaction where available and the existing details-opening fallback for uncovered quests. Experimental route/native test commands are removed. This does not claim full native-header coverage or a taint root-cause fix.
- **Settings:** add a sound-shortcut size control and complete related merchant-setting translations.

**Verification and limits:** the settings search, QuestJournalRC1 and mail collector were approved in the author's installed game setup. Other included changes retain their recorded gameplay checks; this is not exhaustive coverage of every class, locale, combat sequence or long session. QuestJournal/map/Edit Mode taint, native damage-meter restricted-value issues, restricted-combat aspect detection and previously documented intermittent bag/chat limitations remain under investigation. Chat CPU/FPS behavior, broader aura-layout gameplay coverage and PvP range behavior are not fully verified.

Independent products, Quest Call Lab, Private Capture Boot, Private Diagnostics, suite private Boot links, personal records and test fixtures are excluded. CurseForge uses the existing tagged-source webhook route; no duplicate manual ZIP upload is required.

releases.name: KerimAnka UI 0.40.5 — Action Tracker, quest journal and aspect alerts
releases.notes:
# KerimAnka UI 0.40.5 — Action Tracker, quest journal and aspect alerts

This update targets **WoW: Forever (1.60.1)**. The combined suite download preserves **Classic Era 0.37.0 unchanged**. Existing settings and recorded history are retained.

- **Action Tracker:** an optional third tab in Damage Meters shows a short history of successfully used abilities. Choose 1–10 icons (default 5), four growth directions, size, spacing, opacity and a GCD sweep. Melee and ranged auto-attack history have separate switches; auto-attacks do not start a GCD sweep. The tracker is off by default, keeps a bounded history and uses account-wide settings.
- **Layout editing:** Action Tracker is now available in Edit Positions, including disabled-item discovery, dragging, right-click quick settings and temporary sample icons. Save, Cancel, selected-item restore and interrupted-session recovery use the existing editor. Samples are not added to recorded action history.
- **All journal quests:** the quest tracker can show all normal quests from the journal instead of only Blizzard-watched quests. The new option is on by default; turn it off to retain watched-only display. It does not add watches or expand native journal headers. The existing mouse-wheel scrolling option must be enabled. Zone grouping, collapsed sections and scroll position remain supported.
- **Quest menu protection:** View Quest and Stop Tracking check combat again when their menu callbacks run, keeping those native operations out of combat.
- **Aspect alerts:** an optional setting hides ordinary warnings while mounted and resumes them after dismounting. Cheetah and the player's own Pack aspect have separate combat warnings, text and previews. Where supported, combat warnings use the game's aura display. The aspect catalog shows localized names/icons, learned status and valid learning levels supplied by the game; unavailable levels are marked unverified.
- **Settings and translations:** related controls, help and profile fields are updated in all nine supported panel languages. Existing explicit choices are preserved.

**Gameplay verification:** the author confirmed the latest Action Tracker layout integration and all-journal quest display are tested and working, following earlier positive tracker and basic aspect-warning tests. The prepared feature code was compared with the installed files; private observation additions were isolated and excluded. This is not exhaustive coverage of every class, item, combat sequence or locale, and actual CPU/GPU/FPS and long-session measurements remain open.

**Known limitations:** detecting that every aspect is absent during restricted combat remains unresolved; no warning is not proof that an aspect is inactive. Reported QuestJournal aura/Edit Mode taint and native damage-meter restricted-value/freeze issues remain under investigation. The quest-menu guard does not claim to fix their root cause. Previously documented intermittent bag-open/UNKNOWN and combat private-chat limitations also remain open.

Bags, cursor and sound behavior are retained from 0.40.4. Independent editions, private diagnostics/trace/capture addons, personal SavedVariables and test fixtures are excluded from this suite release. CurseForge continues to use the existing automatic tagged-source packaging route; do not upload a duplicate manual ZIP.

releases.name: KerimAnka UI 0.40.4 — Forever cursor and inventory fixes
releases.notes:
# KerimAnka UI 0.40.4 — Forever cursor and inventory fixes

This update targets **WoW: Forever (1.60.1)**. The combined download preserves **Classic Era 0.37.0 unchanged**. Existing settings and recorded history are preserved.

- Inventory: uses fixed physical bag/slot ownership instead of writing the native bag-ID field, preserving native item-click, drag and modified-click handlers.
- Combat inventory: prepares item buttons outside combat for the standard layouts and Organized main/recent/footer views. Missing buttons and bank buttons are deferred until combat ends. Item removal, replacement, count, lock and readable-state updates continue on the existing slot.
- Hunter ammunition: the user successfully changed arrow types during combat, including equipping a newly purchased different type. The change uses the common inventory path; it does not automatically choose ammunition or add item/class exceptions.
- Mouse cursor: adds an optional cursor settings page with configurable shapes, color, size, opacity and visibility, GCD/cast/channel indicators, 2D trails and three built-in native effects (blue flow, blue electric and green electric). Camera initialization before model scaling preserves the latest test13 reload behavior. Native effects reuse game assets; extracted game assets are not distributed.

**Gameplay evidence:** the user reported successful item use/weapon equip in the earlier identity fix and successful arrow changes with the button-preparation fix. The latest cursor test13 received a provisional positive report for all three effects and /reload. These tests used the same feature code with private observation overlays; exact in-memory reconstruction verifies the overlays are the only installed differences. The user subsequently installed clean 0.40.4, reloaded and reported that it works with no current problems and appears stable. The installed 511-file Forever payload was verified against the clean release. This is a basic gameplay/reload approval; it does not establish every combat scenario or long-session performance.

**Hunter sound finding (no new code fix):** the existing six-file error-click mute remains unchanged. Installed Forever Dual Gathering 2.3 can unmute the shared file 567407. Disabling that addon and reloading appeared to restore the desired behavior for the user. This release does not implement a compatibility fix or change the macro; long-session confirmation remains open.

**Limitations:** full restart, long-session and actual CPU/GPU/FPS measurements are pending. Not all classes, item families or the immediate last-arrow-exhaustion sequence were tested in game. Combat-first loading or capacity beyond the prepared reserve can defer missing slots until combat ends. Existing QuestJournal secret-aura/Edit Mode warnings and previously recorded intermittent bag-open/UNKNOWN and combat private-chat limitations remain open; this update does not claim to resolve every protected-action report.

Private Diagnostic, Sound Probe, detailed BagBirth observers, cursor probes, personal SavedVariables and fake test data are excluded. The existing bounded public bag-status/actionlog commands are retained. All eight independent products remain separate, with their own sync/test status. CurseForge uses the existing suite webhook only; no duplicate manual ZIP upload.

releases.name: KerimAnka UI 0.40.3 — Forever economy and inventory improvements
releases.notes:
# KerimAnka UI 0.40.3 — Forever economy and inventory improvements

This update targets **WoW: Forever (1.60.1)**. The combined download preserves **Classic Era 0.37.0 unchanged**. Existing settings and recorded economy history are preserved.

- Auction mail: matches batched money updates to the correct pending sales, prevents item-only mail from duplicating a sale, and keeps earlier pending receipts when a later native mail request fails. Sales and returned deposits remain separate.
- Auction purchases: records the real item ID/link and localized item name when the game's auction cache provides them. Taking an already-paid item from mail does not create a second expense.
- Economy previews: resolves older name-only entries through known account item identities and recorded bag/bank snapshots. Newly observed identities remain available after changing characters or selling an item. Unknown or ambiguous historical items may still have no preview.
- Economy navigation: source/period filters, list tabs, search, sorting and pagination preserve the current viewport position.
- Economy search: common Turkish and Latin accents are optional when searching item names, players, sources and transaction types. For example, `ucus` matches `Uçuş` and `egitim` matches `Eğitim`.
- Travel/training: use the existing transaction search to separate Flight and Training without changing the two-row source grid. Search totals show cash in/out across all matching result pages; the main summaries stay unchanged. Transaction searches cover retained details, not deleted historical records.
- Bag capacity: Classic, Compact and Leather/Metal layouts now explain general versus special space and per-bag free slots on hover, using the same tooltip as Organized. Reagent-only space is identified separately.
- Reagent sorting: routes confirmed crafting reagents into the dedicated reagent bag while preserving narrower profession/ammunition priorities; tools and general items are not guessed to be reagents.
- Quest tracker: keeps the custom secure-item viewport independent of the native tracker frame hierarchy.

**Verification:** one in-game bulk capture matched all 17 sales across 8 money updates. The newer mail-failure path, item metadata, previews, search/totals, bag variants and tracker protection were also checked in local regression tests. Local tests do not replace gameplay coverage of every race, class, locale or mailbox sequence.

**Known issues:** the reported QuestJournal secret-aura taint warning, including the Edit Mode path, remains under investigation. This release does not claim to fix that warning. The intermittent bag-open/UNKNOWN protected-action reports and previously documented combat private-chat limitations also remain unresolved. Old unclassified economy entries are not retroactively rewritten.

Guild bank retains its native appearance by default. Independent editions, private mail-report instrumentation and personal SavedVariables are excluded from the suite release.

releases.name: KerimAnka UI 0.40.2 — Forever bag and chat fixes
releases.notes:
# KerimAnka UI 0.40.2 — Forever bag and chat fixes

This maintenance update targets **WoW: Forever (1.60.1)**. The combined download preserves **Classic Era 0.37.0 unchanged**. Existing settings are preserved.

- Bags: stack-splitting dialogs opened by the modern game API are raised above KerimAnka inventory windows and return to their original layer when closed.
- Sorting: compatible items in ordinary bags are routed into available ammunition, soul and profession bags before the existing sorting passes. Matching partial stacks are filled first; full or unknown bag families retain their safe fallback.
- Inventory interactions: native bag identity is initialized through the game's bag-ID attribute path outside combat, preserving native item-click handlers.
- Chat: restores a displaced, unprotected primary message viewport to its cached position during combat, including level-up refreshes. Protected frames remain untouched.
- Hunter Range and Aspect Alert: removed routine ready messages on login/reload. Functional warnings and manual diagnostic commands remain available.
- Bag troubleshooting: `/kauibags status` now includes the last refresh error or blocked action observed during the current session; it does not add automatic chat messages.

**Gameplay verification:** Hunter ammunition sorting and a fresh character levelling up during combat were tested successfully by the author. Other specialty families and dialog restoration were checked in local regression tests; these are not substitutes for live gameplay coverage.

**Known limitations:** the intermittent report of bags refusing to open has not yet been reproduced conclusively. The exact cause of the reported `UNKNOWN()` protected-action error is also unconfirmed. If bags stop opening, capture `/kauibags status` before reloading. The previously documented combat private-tab limitations remain; this update does not claim to resolve them completely.

Guild bank keeps its original native appearance by default. Independent editions, personal SavedVariables and private diagnostic traces are excluded.
